candidates.citation: USFS Mendocino National Forest — Letts Lake Campground (Overview)

parameters.description: Letts Lake sits in the USFS Letts Lake Campground recreation area (Stonyford Recreation Area, Mendocino National Forest); the lake is limited to non-motorized vessels.

candidates.summary: Non-motorized vessels only on the lake (USFS Mendocino National Forest recreation area)

schedule.note: CDFW's 2026 Provisional Stocking Document for Trout and Inland Salmon lists Letts Lake (Region 2, Colusa Co.) for catchable-size Rainbow Trout under the Put and Take program, with a stated release month range of March-June. This is CDFW's provisional plan for 2026, not a guaranteed annual constant.
